scope: Development chronology from executed isolated UsageBreakdownPanel browser runs. Historical counts below are not cumulative and do not replace the latest qa-usage-ui-report.json.

findings.detail: The Playwright CLI run-code context has no URL global. Initial harness stopped after 12 checks; the browser fixture switched to a bounded query parser for its own authored ASCII URLs. This was not a product runtime error.

The initial functional run passed, but review of actual component screenshots showed inline small elements joining 5 / 2 and 1 HTTP error into an apparent 5 / 21, plus joined token coverage. Product owner added scoped block note rendering, larger readable metadata and wrapping. Fixture parent wrappers were corrected to the actual ad-shell/ad-main/ad-content/ad-panel hierarchy.

After the number-separation fix, a long synthetic model identifier still collapsed to a narrow row-header column on 390/768px layouts. Product owner added a scoped row-header minimum width; the next run checked readable normal identifiers and bounded wrapping of complete long identifiers.

72 checks passed with 12 intercepted synthetic GET requests, zero runtime errors and zero provider/public calls. Ordinary identifier remained on one line; the complete long identifier wrapped to ten lines at 390/768px. Window and all-age journal-capacity diagnostics were added subsequently and require a separate final rerun.

After the all-age journal-capacity extension, 79 checks passed. Nine retained records, three all-age unresolved intents and two outside-window unresolved intents stay separate from the seven-attempt/one-unresolved selected-window cohort. Per-account/global pending caps and overall journal capacity are labelled independently. All three final PNGs were visually reviewed. Twelve intercepted synthetic GETs; no React runtime error, provider/public call, real account or cost claim.
